overview_description.description:
Ekshef is trying to facilitate interaction between people and doctors in the middle east

Ekshef’s interactive directory allows users to search for doctors using several ways including name, specialty, place, price range, medical insurance and availability. The top results the user sees are doctors recommended by his/her friends on Facebook. The user can also know the doctor’s rating, read reviews about the service & see what friends said about it. This allows the user to save time & effort in finding the right doctor, and get all related information before visiting the clinic. 

On the other side, doctors are welcomed to upload their specialties and clinics details to the website to start being recommended by people. Ekshef provides details for various specialties varying from internal medicine, dental, physiotherapy, Eyes, Orthopedics, ENT, gynecology, obstetrics and many other important specialties Egyptian citizens need to gain access to.

product.name: Booking Service
product.description: A platform to book appointments with doctors in Egypt, allowing users to choose based on location, ratings, or price.

product.name: Doctor Account Management
product.description: A service for doctors to create and manage their profiles, including appointment schedules and patient reviews.

product.name: Medical Blog
product.description: An online resource providing articles on various medical topics, including symptoms, causes, and treatments of different health conditions.

product.name: Specialized Doctor Search
product.description: A search tool to find specialized doctors in fields like dentistry, gynecology, pediatrics, internal medicine, orthopedics, general surgery, ENT, ophthalmology, dermatology, and neurology based on location and availability.

product.name: Patient Reviews
product.description: A feature that displays genuine patient reviews for each doctor, helping users make informed decisions.
